The effect of varying aerobic frequencies on muscular adaptations was directly studied in the context of a concurrent training program

## KEY POINT

If hypertrophy is the desired outcome, the frequency of aerobic endurance training should remain low and a lengthy intervening recovery period should be inserted between aerobic and resistance bouts. Perhaps even better, the two should be performed on separate days.
book: Science and Development of Muscle Hypertrophy
chapter: Chapter 6: Role of Aerobic Training in Hypertrophy
